reviewSummary: Thirty-two attacks run against the D-340 draft; thirty-two refuted; none sustained. The subject is unmoved at a6e72109... mode 0444; HEAD, live COORD and file 08 are unmoved at the dispatch digests, and this review edited none of them and created no commit. Every cited digest recomputes: the frozen successor, both Stage A v10 reviews, the v9 successor and both its Stage A reviews, and the v8 predecessor. Both Stage A return shapes are reproduced member by member without flattening, including Claude's four observation objects against Codex's empty observations list and all three counts as the number 0. Every identifier resolves to live bytes and none is invented: OB-1 through OB-4 of the v10, v9 and v8 Claude Stage A returns are each named under their own source, all four CLAUDE-G30LJ-V9 finding ids are named as landed at leftover-join.v10 of G30, and the unlabeled Codex v9 SHOULD-FIX is recited as unlabeled with no id member. leftoverDesign is recited as [] against the successor's empty summary.leftoverDesign, and the three staleness measurements — OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING, the seven D-317 implementations, the twenty-eight D-339 copies — each match the successor's leftoverDesignOpenStanding and execute D-339's own routing to a leftover-join successor of leftover-join.v8 of G30 rather than unwriting it. Staleness of an authoring claim is not smuggled into closure: DR-G30 stays OPEN, the candidate binds NOTHING, nothing is marked SATISFIED, file 08 is untouched, required-now stays 28, condition 2 stays 5 of 32 and condition 4 stays MET at 28 of 28. leftover-join.v9, v7, v6 and v5 of G30 stay unrecorded, v8 of G30 stays the D-321 current recording until this successor is recorded, v4 of G30 is historical after D-321, D-319 is not treated as a recorded heading and does not exist as one, the no-cell-edit branch excludes D-236 and increments its terminus to D-339 by exactly one heading, and no deictic or bare version token stands anywhere in the draft.
decision: CONSENT - 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Thirty-two attacks run, thirty-two refuted.
observations: The draft's parenthetical member list for the four Claude Stage A leftover-join.v10 of G30 observation objects reads (members id, observation, severity, where, whyItDoesNotStand). Those five members are present on all four objects, but OB-1 and OB-2 additionally carry a suggestionForALaterCycle member. The recital is true and under-inclusive rather than false, it is the member list the dispatch prescribed verbatim and instructed reviewers to cite without flattening, and it describes honesty work that binds nothing. It does not stand as a finding.

The draft recites 'leftoverDesign is []' without naming the path summary.leftoverDesign. The successor carries exactly one array-valued leftoverDesign member, at summary.leftoverDesign, and it is empty; the six obligations[].leftoverDesign members are booleans and all false. The recital is therefore unambiguous against these bytes, and the unpathed form is precedented in COORD ('leftoverDesign remains []', 'leftoverDesign is `[]`'). A later entry naming the partition explicitly would be marginally harder to misread.

OB-1 through OB-4 serve three different Stage A Claude returns inside this one draft: leftover-join.v10, leftover-join.v9 and leftover-join.v8 of G30, the last carrying only OB-1 through OB-3. Every occurrence is qualified by its source artifact in the same sentence, so nothing is ambiguous here. Any later recital that drops the source qualifier would become ambiguous, and this is worth carrying forward.

The draft attributes the four platform strings to occupancy v2 ('Occupancy v2 platforms are quoted, not invented'). That attribution is the successor's own sentence and all four strings are present in the occupancy v2 bytes, which are tracked and unmodified. The same four platforms are also the D-002 platform axis under which the twenty-eight copies were made, so the sentence sits next to the draft's separate denial of inventing a D-002 platform list; keeping the 'quoted, not invented' hedge on both is what stops the two from being read as one claim.
